visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a screen recording of an Elon Musk tweet showing a spinning Mars globe. This is followed by a close-up of three MOVA globes, including Mars and Earth, rotating slowly on clear acrylic stands on a white surface with high-key lighting. (2) A male host with short brown hair, wearing a black pinstriped blazer over a black shirt, appears in a studio setting. He looks directly at the camera with an animated expression. A film clapperboard is visible in the blurred background. (3) The screen transitions to a website interface for MOVA Globes, showing various planetary models. A hand reaches out to place a blue Earth globe onto its stand. The scene cuts to a close-up of dark, glossy boba pearls being lifted by a metal spoon. (4) Footage displays fitness activities: a woman in a grey sports bra performs crunches on a green Wonder Core machine, and a shirtless man uses a chest-expanding device. (5) The male host returns to the screen, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his points. A brief clip shows a woman at a laptop looking stressed while talking on a phone, with text overlays regarding logistics. (6) The Amazon logo appears, followed by a promotional graphic for the 2025 Taiwan Cross-border E-commerce Summit. A panel of seven speakers is shown in a grid layout. (7) Footage from a previous event shows a large hall filled with a seated audience and people on stage next to a giant white Amazon-branded balloon. The host concludes by pointing towards the information bar for registration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy male Mandarin narration begins immediately alongside a rhythmic, upbeat electronic pop track. The speaker's pitch is moderate but highly varied to maintain engagement. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the shift from the globe footage to the host in the studio. The BGM remains consistent with a steady 4/4 drum beat and synth chords. (3) As the host lists specific product brands like O's Bubble and Wonder Core, subtle 'pop' sound effects accentuate the on-screen graphics. The narration remains fast and enunciated. (4) The vocal tone shifts slightly to a more informative, serious pitch while discussing logistics and finance challenges, though the BGM maintains its driving tempo. (5) A 'ding' sound effect highlights the appearance of the Amazon logo. The host's arousal level increases as he introduces the 2025 Summit, concluding with a rising intonation on the final call to action, while the BGM reaches a peak energetic volume before a clean fade.
